lane: A - city / county / state / local sources (national, federal, private and global sources are lane B: licence_registry_national.json)
rule: STRICT clear-green only: terms must EXPLICITLY allow commercial use and redistribution (US federal work / public-domain dedication, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, ODbL, ODC-BY/PDDL, an open-government licence, or a city/county open-data licence page that explicitly permits reuse). Disclaimer-only, terms-unstated, 'use limitations: None', 'verify', non-commercial, internal-use, do-not-share, all-rights-reserved, or special commercial-purpose regimes (A.R.S. 39-121.03, Texas appraisal districts) = grey/red -> remove or replace. Facts summarised in our own words with a link (PHA payment standards, program descriptions) need no licence.
method: Listed every endpoint in usa/adapters/*.py, usa/local_sources.json, usa/local_flags.py, usa/assistance_flags.py local inputs, usa/road_traffic.py (state DOTs), usa/tourism_econ.py (state/city STR + HOT feeds), mpls/*.py and dallas/*.py. ArcGIS services resolved to serviceItemId and the ArcGIS Online item licenseInfo read via sharing/rest; Socrata licences via /api/views/<id>.json; CKAN via package_show; portal terms pages (Denver, KCMO, Boulder County, Dallas, Minneapolis, Saint Paul, Phoenix, Maricopa Assessor, DCAD, Metro Transit) read with Python requests and the built-in browser. No Firecrawl; no terms or login gates accepted (EDI login and the Phoenix bot check were not passed).

This dataset is public domain under the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act (Minnesota Statutes Chapter 13).'

US Census TIGER/Line roads (public domain) or OpenStreetMap (ODbL).

Boulder County 'Assessor's Property Data' bulk CSVs (Buildings, All Sales, Property Values, Land; https://www.bouldercounty.org/property-and-land/assessor/data-download/), catalog item d39100d04be34354b97ad52874f5e7d4 licensed https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ; parcel geometry from catalog item 90e3547382df4d498b779672d2685b0b 'Parcels (with address and ownership information)' (CC BY 4.0; do not read owner fields).

City of Boulder 'Code Enforcement Reports' (https://gis.bouldercolorado.gov/ags_svr1/rest/services/plan/CodeEnforcement/MapServer/0, item a703fa3a075e43b09de13e3abd61bef4): 'Creative Commons CC Zero license (CC0 1.0)'; responds, 27,451 rows.
City of Boulder 'Zoning Districts' (https://gis.bouldercolorado.gov/ags_svr1/rest/services/plan/ZoningDistricts/MapServer/0, item e88004e26b9e42cfba32129fb8731f41): CC0 1.0; responds.

City of Cincinnati Open Data lists 'Hamilton County Parcel Polygons' (https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/d/g24g-2pi5) with licence 'Public Domain', access point CAGIS item 9ab9d942593d4b0fb06a8e99e7e0ff23 layer 0 - re-point the adapter there and cite the city listing (check it carries the value/class fields used).
'Hamilton County Zoning Designation' (https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/d/f25h-aupn, Public Domain) only if it covers the City of Cincinnati; otherwise drop zoning.

City of Cincinnati Open Data 'Hamilton County Subdivision Boundaries' (https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/d/rynu-bywd, licence 'Public Domain', access point CAGIS c476f99bde094b9a8bff26b9ace21f17 layer 3).

notes: used_in[].outputs names the keys a filter must strip for that source. Adapter outputs (houses[].assessor, houses[].permits, layers.permits, ...) are per city: strip them only on blocks whose meta.city_data.adapter is that city.
When an assessor source is removed, re-run usa/city_enrich.py without it so houses[].money falls back to the ACS census-tract median (federal, green), instead of deleting houses[].money outright.
usa/local_sources.json commercial_ok is stale for mpls_rental (actually CC BY-SA 4.0) and for the Denver items (licence comes from the catalog terms, not the item text).
Borderline calls the owner may want to review: mndot_aadt (grey: 'Use limitations: None').
fra_parcels / fra_condo: moved to grey + removed (owner: no clear legal standing); Columbus blocks fall back to the ACS tract median, parcels: [] and City of Columbus CC0 plats only.
